concepts.gloss_en: When a person desires all the more — intensified longing (proportional to the obstacle) empowers one to break the obstacle and bring the matter from potential to actual

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are in the same paragraph (lm1:66) and state the identical principle — greater desire overcomes/breaks the obstacle. The second form simply adds the qualifier 'כפי המניעה' (in proportion to the obstacle) but expresses the same idea with the same words. Clean merge.
